# Stall Wise

Stall Wise is a zero-commission multi-vendor marketplace. Any seller can open a shop at stallwise.in/{handle}, list products with options (size, colour) and stock, share one link, and receive payments directly into their own Razorpay account.

## Key facts
- Commission: 0%. Stall Wise never takes a cut of a sale.
- Payments: direct to the seller's own Razorpay account. No escrow, no holding period, no payout request.
- Pricing: Free (shop shows Stall Wise ads). Stall Wise Pro removes ads for ₹149/month or ₹999/year.
- Delivery: confirmed by a one-time code sent to the buyer, followed by a dispute window. After the window closes the order is final.
- Auth: email/password or Google sign-in.
